purpose: Pre-registered chronological comparison of no-text / repaired-regex-text / hosted-LLM-text race forecasts, to run UNCHANGED once the text_archive corpus has timestamped history reaching into a development window step 10 never scored a text arm on.
eligible_population: market_type == 'WIN', race_uid grouping, identical to step 10's run_manifest.json eligible_population -- no new eligibility rule.

text_join.decision_cutoff: race off-time (parsed from race_uid) minus PREDICTION_CUTOFF_MINUTES_BEFORE_OFF (10, CONTRACTS.md provisional research assumption)
text_join.lookup: llm.text_archive.TextArchive.as_of(archive_key(race_uid), runner_key, as_of=cutoff) -- filters strictly on fetched_at <= cutoff, never archived_at or published_at
exclusions: records whose race_uid does not parse to a local datetime
records with no resolvable runner_key (missing horse_name AND horse_id)
any archived version fetched after the decision cutoff (a later report/edit)

arms.name: hosted_text
arms.feature_cols: no_text + CANDIDATE_TEXT_FEATURE_COLS, extractor=llm.hosted_adapter.OpenRouterBackend(model='deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash', reasoning_effort='low', max_output_tokens=1600) -- included ONLY because step 15 produced valid reviewed evidence for this exact configuration

tuning_budget: 6 trials / 5-fold walk-forward CV, matching step 10's run_manifest.json tuning_budget -- no new budget chosen for this stage
metrics: calibration (ECE / odds-band A-E, mirroring step 12's calibration audit)
subgroup counts: rows/races per arm, per window, with vs without archived text at cutoff
race-clustered bootstrap CI95 of the paired log-loss delta (mirrors step 11/13's paired_bootstrap)
cost (USD/1000 comments), latency (ms), schema_valid_rate -- reused from step 15's scorecards for the hosted arm, not re-measured unless the corpus changes
reporting_requirement: Both the common-coverage comparison (rows where ALL three arms have a resolvable value) and full operational coverage (every eligible row, missing text scored as the no-text default) must be reported side by side, so a result cannot look better merely because text-covered races are easier.
prohibited: loading final_holdout_RESERVED_UNTOUCHED rows into any fit, CV fold, or score
retrofitting a published_at onto an unknown-published_at archive row
treating a common-coverage-only result as if it were the full-population result
claiming forecast improvement from a comparison that does not include a genuine out-of-sample (dev_oos or later) window
status_rule: If coverage_report.json shows zero archived-text races in dev_oos AND final_holdout, this protocol CANNOT be executed as a real ablation -- record DEFERRED_DATA (Candidate enabled: no) and keep text features disabled, per prompts/16-text-feature-ablation.md's own exception clause. A smoke-test run restricted to dev_core's own archived day is permitted ONLY to prove the harness executes end-to-end; it must never be reported as satisfying this protocol's acceptance criteria.
